title: Review
description: Validates the Codex Reviewer findings artifact for the Supervisor-CAO platform. A review records the reviewer's decision (APPROVED or CHANGES_REQUESTED) and a structured list of findings, each with severity, category, location, claim, evidence, and a recommended direction. PUBLIC schema: sanitized, contains no secrets, hostnames, or private paths.

review_id.description: Stable unique identifier for the review.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task whose candidate is being reviewed.

candidate_sha.description: Git SHA of the candidate commit submitted for review.

reviewed_sha.description: Git SHA actually reviewed (may differ from candidate_sha if the reviewer rebased or checked out a different ref).

decision.description: Reviewer's overall decision on the candidate.

id.description: Stable identifier for the finding, unique within the review.

severity.description: Severity of the finding: P0 (blocker) through P3 (nit).

file.description: Path of the file the finding concerns.

line.description: Line number in the file the finding concerns, when applicable.

claim.description: Concise statement of the issue the finding raises.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete scenario under which this finding could cause a failure, when applicable.

evidence.description: Evidence supporting the finding (e.g. quoted code, log excerpt, test output).

recommended_direction.description: Suggested direction for resolving the finding (not a prescriptive patch).

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the review.

model.description: Identifier of the model that produced the review.
